segments.text: I would like to welcome everyone

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Welcome everyone to this budget hearing of the Commission on Elections headed by Chairman George

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Erwin M. Garcia. The budget of the Commission on Elections for fiscal year 2027 amounting

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: to 29.5 billion pesos, inclusive of the automatic appropriations for retirement and life insurance

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: premiums amounting to 339.88 million pesos. In terms of new appropriations, which is subject

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: for congressional approval, the total budget of the COMELEC amounts to 29.16 billion pesos

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: representing an increase of about 46.7 percent or 9.3 billion pesos higher than the

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: fiscal year 2026 level of 19.87 billion pesos 23.92 billion pesos for the preparatory national

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: and local elections is included for the preparations for the 2028 elections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: The COMELEC is the principal government agency tasked to enforce and administer all laws and

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: regulations concerning the conduct of regular and special elections. Under our Constitution,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: it is a body designed to be independent from the executive, legislative, and

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: judicial branches of government to ensure the conduct of free, fair, and honest elections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: More importantly, our Constitution grants fiscal autonomy to the COMELEC to enable them to operate

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: from political interference. It provides that funds certified by the Commission as necessary

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: to defray the expenses for holding regular and special elections, plebiscites, initiatives, referenda

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: and recalls will be provided in the regular or special appropriations

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: and once approved, will be released automatically upon certification by the Chairman of the

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Commission. With the presence of our COMELEC officials, we look forward to an efficient and

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia, you may now proceed with your presentation.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: budget for the 2027 year and which will happen to be the year prior to the election of 2028

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: initial statement i would like to respectfully announce to you

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Commission election during the last year of fiscal year 2025. For 2025, of course, we conducted the

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: national and local elections, a very successful election. It was actually the fastest in the

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: history of our country in a midterm election. We were able to proclaim the senator in five days.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: We were able to proclaim the mayors and the governors on the night of the election or the

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: next day after the election. We were able to proclaim the party's congressman seven days

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: after the election. Indeed, actually, it likewise resulted to an 81.7 percent. Voters turned out the

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: highest in a midterm election. Our highest was the 2022 election, the presidential election, which

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: was actually 83 percent. Your Comelec was likewise awarded the commission of the year by an

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: international body, and it was likewise recognized by electing us for the first time in the history

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Comelec, and the history likewise of the world electoral body and the association of electoral

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: authorities. The Comelec was elected both chairperson in both of these world electoral bodies. So we

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: will be assuming chairmanship by the month of October. That's actually a recognition, perhaps,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: of what the Comelec is doing, and perhaps they're likewise using the Comelec's model as their model

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: in the conduct of their election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Likewise, for the information of this honorable body, your Comelec for three consecutive years, first time po, three consecutive years, we were given an unqualified opinion by the Commission on Audit.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Meaning to say, kahit paano po, maayos yung pananalapinang Comelec, maayos yung libro namin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And therefore, that is because we wanted to ensure the greatest transparency that is possible for purposes of at least expending the people's money.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And likewise, in the recent survey conducted by a survey organization, we were given likewise an 81.65%, a 96% trust rating when it comes to the machines, and likewise a 67% trust rating when it comes to the Commission on Election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: For the 2025, our absorptive capacity or financial utilization rate is 99.73%.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Medyo mataas po yung 2025 namin na financial utilization.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And yung case disposition po namin is 62.47%.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: In 2025, the number of cases that reached the Comelec was about 14,000.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ngayon po, ang amin pong cases na lamang, especially sa Club of the Commission, mga more or less 400 na lamang po.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung mga cases to be disposed by the Commission on Election, regardless of the nature of the cases.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Now, when it comes to our proposal for 2027 fiscal year, we would like to respectfully appeal to the kindness of this honorable committee.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: We were reduced by as much as almost, yung pong budget namin was reduced by as much as almost 23 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: In fact, dun lang po sa preparatory national and local election, we were reduced by about 9 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung budget para sa Comelec of about 6 billion, yung regular budget namin, 15 billion po yung tinanggal sa amin, sa NEP.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And that is so unfortunate because I'm going to explain with your kind permission, ano-ano po ba yung mga tinanggal na yun na maaari po maka-apekto.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi ko na po muna sasabing maka-apekto. Gamitin ko na lang po muna yung word.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: It may definitely affect the conduct of our election for 2028.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Registered voters as projected by 2028 is more or less 74 million.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And then because of our continuing registration, yung pinagkaabalahan talaga ng Comelec, tumaas po ito hanggang 71 million voters.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ngayon po, by 2028, we are projecting a 74 million number of registered voters.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pag po 74 million number of registered voters, ibig sabihin po, tataas ang bilang ng mga presinto ng ating pong bansa.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Nung nakarang election, we will readily admit, masyado pong mahaba ang pila, sapagkat kinakailangan kung ano po yung budget na nabigay sa amin, yun lang po ang perpwede naming ma-lease ng mga machines.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Umabot lang po kami ng 800 to 1,000 voters.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Simply because we were just limited to 107,000 precincts nationwide.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Halos 7,000 ang aming pong excess machines pang palit kung sakasakali.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ngayon po, kung sakasakaling masusunod po yung binigay sa aming budget, nababawasan po kami ng 9 billion.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: With your kind permission, may I invite your attention sa ating pong screen.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Una pong binawasan sa amin, your honors, yung pong aming machines.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: For the first time in the history of our country's automated election, simula po ng 2010, sa 2025 elections, hindi po tayo bumili ng machines.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Nag-list lang po tayo ng machines.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And because of the list of the machines, ang aming pong market scoping, market survey, dapat 155,000 pesos per machine.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: But doong lumabas po yung mismong procurement, lumalabas po 149,000 lamang ang naging offer sa amin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So we were able to at least save 800 million pesos because of the list of machines.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pag po hindi tayo bumili ng machines, number one, hindi po tayo nagwe-warehouse.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Number two, hindi po tayo nag-upgrade.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi rin po tayo nag-maintain ng ating mga makina.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Napaka-importante po yan because napaka-mahal po ng warehousing, ng maintenance, at saka po improvement of the machines.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And after the 2025 election, one-time use, meaning after the 2025 elections, there will be a separate and a different provider by 2028 based on the new terms of reference.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kung kaya lang po, nakat po ng 1.5 billion.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang 1.5 billion po is equivalent to more or less, short po kami, ng 9,000, your honors, 310 machines.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: We hope to be able to start the filing of the candidacies by next year.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Dapat po ay October 1 to 7 tayo ng 2025.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ngayon po, we wanted to have the filing of the candidacy by September 20 to 27.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: More or less yung po yung filing natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Mas maaga ng ilang araw lang.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Because we wanted to print the ballots by December of 2027.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung pong pinopropose sa amin, and I will explain later,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: gusto po nilang mangyari na 2028 na lang kami mag-print ng balota.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kaya po importante yung 2027 September because pag natapos po kami ng registration of voters likewise by September 30,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: we wanted to finalize the list of voters ng bawat distrito niyo po, we wanted to finalize by the month of November.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Dapat po pumasok na yung mga petisyon for exclusivity.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Dapat po malinis na ang list of voters natin by November of 2027.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Because we wanted to print the ballots by the second week or even kahit po Christmas time by third week of December.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Because we wanted to avoid what happened in 2026 na nag-filing po tayo ng candidacy no October 1 to 7.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Nag-hintay po kami kung ano ang aksyon sa mga dinisqualify namin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And we'd like to announce to you for 2025, wala po kami kahit isa na NUISAN's candidates.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: We were able to resolve the 153 NUISAN's cases all in all up to the NBank level by November 30.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Meaning to say, pagdating po ng 1st of December, handa na po kami sa list of voters.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pag po automated election, we have to print the names.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Of the candidates sa balota natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And therefore, we cannot afford an injunction, a restraining order from the Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: What happened in 2025 was that, second week of January, nag-print na po kami na more or less 6 million ballots.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Then, a restraining order was issued as against the Comelec in favor of one candidate for national position.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Wala po sanong problema kung local.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kasi hindi pa naman po kami nagsisimula.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Doon sa mga local positions na...

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pero sa national po, meron kasing nakakuha ng isang restraining order.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: We have to reprint anew the ballot so that the name of that candidate will have to be included.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So ngayon po gusto namin sana mas maaga tayo mag-file.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Para maaga po namin makumpleto ang list of candidates.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At the same time, makumpleto rin yung list of voters po natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So therefore, critical po ang 2027 sa preparation natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi po dapat pinagkakasya ang lahat sa 2028.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kasi po sa 2028, kung ang election natin is May,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: napakahira po na January, February, March, magpuprint ka ng balota.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pag may nagka-problema, you have to repeat.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And magkakakompromise yung printing natin ng balota.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So dito po sa makina namin, ang projection po namin,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: yung pong dapat na machines natin for 2028 election ay 124,000.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: But because of the cut of from 23 billion to 16, magiging 21.66,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: 8,000 po more or less ang mawawalang machines sa Comelec.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pagka po hindi po naibalik sa amin yun,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: we will resort to likewise increasing the number of voters per precinct muli.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang plano po sana ni Comelec, 600 voters lang per precinct.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Para po mas maliging maayos ang pagboto ng mga kababayan natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: the budget will not be restored, 800 to 1,000 pumuli.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So masisisi na naman po si Comelec bakit ganun kadami ang votante per precinct,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: kahit yung mga nakatatanda may kapansanan,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: simply because what was given to us only was

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So ang sa amin po, ito po talaga ipinapakiusap namin na sana man lang makapag-list tayo ng 124,310 machines

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: sapagkat yung 10,000 po dyan ay contingency machines.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: For the first time also in 2025, your honors, tayo po ay nagkaroon ng 10 machines bawat munisipyo as contingency.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Nagkaroon din po tayo ng contingency machines sa lahat ng provincial offices of the commission.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Meaning to say, kung nagka-problema sa Cebu halimbawa na anuman po ang nangyari, naandyan lagi yung machine na pwede namin ipampalit.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Wala po tayong naging problema na major during the last election of 2025.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: That's why it's the fastest election in the history without sacrificing the credibility.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: In fact, ang ating po random manual audit resulted to a 99.999973% accuracy rating.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And yung po ang pinakamataas so far na accuracy ng ating po machine versus the manual count of the ballot since 2010.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung po next, your honors, if I may please invite your attention.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: E yung pong printing of ballots.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ibig sabihin po, ang nire-request po namin is 3.2 billion.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: 1.7 billion po dyan, your honors, ay printing ng official ballots.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At 800 million po ang ating voters information sheet.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yan po yung four pages na pinamamahagi natin sa lahat ng botante.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At pagkatapos po, magpiprint din kami ng pampaskil sa labas ng presinto na list of voters.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Na list kung saan pumipirma yung mga botante natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: That's why we asked for 3.2 billion.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Binigyan lang po kami, your honors, ng 348.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ibig sabihin po, hindi po kami makakapagprint ng balota by 2027.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Meaning po, kung ano man po yung kailangan printing, sa 2027 namin i-request for 2028 budget.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Therefore, makakapag-start lang po kami ng procurement, kahit po yan ay National Printing Office,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: still we have to conduct procurement process by January of 2028.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kahit pa nga po mag-early procurement, short of award kami.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Meaning, no printing can be done by Comelec.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kung binigyan po kami ng 348, ano lang po mapiprint namin doon?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Siguro po mapiprint namin doon, list of voters.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yun lang po mapiprint namin, but not the ballots.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, critical po na maiprepare na natin ang ballots by December,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: so that by February, tapos po ang printing ng balota natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
segments.text: for the restoration because of the dangers that we will be facing

segments.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
segments.text: if Comelec does not get at least a fair share.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
segments.text: of the budget that they are asking for.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
segments.text: But at the same time po, I hope that you will also try to resolve cases speedily po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
segments.text: Kasi the thing I hate the most is when a case is filed, tapos muntik na mag-election,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
segments.text: So if we can avoid that and resolve things faster siguro, I would much appreciate it po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jonathan Keith T. Flores
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: We will submit, Mr. Chair, the list and then we will likewise submit to the Committee on Electoral Reforms

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Thank you, Representative Jonathan Kit Flores.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Next in line, from the minority, Representative Elijah San Fernando.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Chair Garcia, magandang hapon po sa Comelec family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Meron lang po ilang mga paglilinaw na nais makuhang kinatawang ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Regarding po ito sa BARM elections,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: just recently po, meron pong kinansila ng candidacy ang Comelec.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Pupwede niyo po ba kaming bigyan ng briefer or ng background as to what led to the cancellation of his candidacy?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Without violating, because this is a hearing, without violating the rule on subjudice,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: simply because we are fully aware that our decision will be elevated to the Supreme Court by the respondent,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: the reason is because of the lack of residency.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Doon po kasi ay nagkaroon ng certification.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: mismo ang barangay na siya ay hindi domiciled doon sa area.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: May decision po tayo, three cases by the Supreme Court,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: that the Comelec should give the highest consideration to a certification issued by the barangay,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: being the one in charge of the place.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So yung po ang isa sa mga naging dahilan that to the belief of the Commission,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: not only based on that but based on other evidence available,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: he was not able to establish domicile in that place.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Chair Garcia, doon po sa sagot niyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kaya ako po ito na tanong, Mr. Chair, kasi hindi lang ito solely election issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: This has something to do with the peace process happening in BARM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Na alam naman po natin, kaya nagkakaroon ng eleksyon ngayon sa BARM,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ay dahil yan yung matagal na pangarap na ng mga kapatid nating Bangsamoro for self-determination.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So hindi po natin po pwedeng maipaghiwalay yung prosesong elektoral sa proseso ng usapingan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ngayon po, Chair Garcia, sa tingin niyo po ba, kasi ito pong si Mr. Anwar Alamada,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: siya po ay isang senior MILF official, freedom fighter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: At alam naman po natin, bilang isang freedom fighter doon po sa conflict areas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: talagang wala siyang mapagtitirmisan na lugar kung saan siya nakatira.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ngayon kinukonsidera ng Commission on Elections, itong nuances on the ongoing peace negotiations

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: and the rules na nag-govern dito po sa mga tumatakbong kandidato.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: At yun po yung sinusunod ng Comelec.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Salamat po, Mr. Chair. Tama po ang inyong napuntos.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At kung yan man po ay gray area, Mr. Chair, yun din po ang kadahilanan kung bakit minarapat ni Comelec

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: na desisyonan ang kaso na ito.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Una po, Mr. Chair, to protect the interest of Mr. Alamada,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: we did not remove his name sa balota.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pinrint po namin yung kanyang pangalan sa balota.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Number two, hindi po namin sinagad ang paglalabas ng desisyon until September 14.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pwede po sana namin gawin yun.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ginawa po namin last week, nilabas ka agad namin yung desisyon

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: para meron po siyang sufficient time to go to the Honorable Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So that kung if people will still be voting for him,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: or especially if he is able to get a restraining order,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: then at least po, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: lahat po ng voto niya will be considered,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: valid at hindi po siya makukonsider na stray votes.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At least binigyan po namin ng panahon siya.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At least po, yung more than two weeks na yan,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: hopefully po makapunta siya sa Korte Suprema.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Number three, talaga pong sana because of this case,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: maging opportunity po ito sa ating kataas-taasang hukuman

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: upang malinaw yung mga ganyang bagay.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: For example, tama po yung binabanggit ng inyong,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Paano yung halimbawa po yung ating mga kababayan,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: na peripatetic, yung bang meron siyang,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: meron po siya ay nangangalaka lang,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: pagkatapos ay napupunta sa bawat bayan,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: saan mo siya kukonsider na domicile?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Tama po kayo, walang domicile yung technically eh,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: but we have to understand that situation.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Our problem po talaga lang, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: is because of the requirements of the Local Government Code,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: of the requirements of the Bangsamoro Electoral Code,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: and of the consistent decision of the Supreme Court

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, sana nga po, mag-grab itong opportunity ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: maliwanag talaga ito, to protect the interest,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: not only of Mr. Alamada, but likewise,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: those who will be facing the same predicament in the future.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Chair Garcia, dun po sa sagot ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Maaaring makatulong po ito para doon sa pagresolba

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: sa mga ganitong usapin at sa mga susunod pang usapin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mr. Chair, kaya ako lang naman po ito binibigyang din,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: dahil mahalaga po na maipasok sa usapin ng eleksyon sa BARM,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ulit yung ongoing na peace negotiation

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: between the Government of the Republic of the Philippines

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, paramount po kasi yung usapin ng self-determination.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, yun po ang tinitindigan natin na mapagpas siya dito sa usapin ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Pero, I am satisfied po sa sagot po ni Chair Garcia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Chair, at sa buong Comelec family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair, your Honor.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Magandang hapon po sa ating kagalang-galang na chairperson,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Chair Garcia, and the rest of the Comelec family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: So, may mga ano lang po ako concerned,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: or mga questions po, katanungan, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Unahin ko muna po yung ating barangay NSK elections po sa November.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: according to Comelec, sinabi po nila, sinabi na around,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: out of, around 8 billion of approximately 19 billion of the BSKE budget had already been spent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: With most of the balance intended for poll worker honorary training and development,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: and another 2.5 to 3.5 billion could be required pag na-postpone po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Ano na po ba yung status ngayon po dun sa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: preparation po, at yung ina-mention niyo po na 8 billion na nag-gastos niya na po?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ah, lahat po ng mga kagamitan na gagamitin natin para sa barangay NSK elections noong November 2 ay nakahanda na.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po yung mga balota.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: In fact, yung pong mga dagdag na balota, dahil nagkaroon po tayo ng dagdag na botante,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: nagkaroon po tayo ng registration from October 20 to May 18 ng 2020, ah, 2027, ah, 2026,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: and therefore, nagkaroon po tayo ng dagdag na, hindi po muna namin i-imprinta yun,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: ah, pero later on, ma-i-imprinta na namin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung pong mga iba pang dapat mag-procure, hindi po muna namin pinadeliver, pero nabili na rin po namin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, ibig sabihin po, anytime, kahit po magpahold tayo ng election by next week, pwede namin isagawa ang barangay NSK.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang kulang po namin lang na major, as number one, yung po training ng mga guro.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: We'll have to train the more or less 1 million teachers, ah, the members of the electoral board,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: including the support staff, kasi po manual na election ang barangay NSK.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And therefore, pati po yung mga DESO. And therefore, kailangan po namin ma-train sila.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At ah, dahil po dyan, yun na lang po yung critical na kulang ni Commission on Election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung ballot boxes po, nakapag-procure kami ng dagdag na 70,000.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At anytime, pwede po namin pa-deliver yun, tutal bakal naman po yung mga ballot boxes na yan.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yun nga lang po, yung deployment, yun na lang po hinihintay natin para ma-deploy yung mga kagamitan natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ah, kasi kaya po nagpasabi po ang inyong lingkod sa ating pong Kongreso,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: nung magkaroon ng pagdinig dito po at sa mataas na kapulungan sa Senado,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: na baka po pwede naman bago po matapos ang buwan ng September,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: ay maging maliwanag kung talagang matutuloy o hindi ang halalan.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At ah, ang nangyari naman po sa Senado kasi ay hindi po siya, ah, postponement

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: kung hindi po, ah, fixing of the term from four years to five years.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At dito po sa mababang kapulungan, nagkaroon na rin po ng pagdinig nung nakaraang linggo,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: ay term fixing na rin po ang dininig po ng local government committee.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So yan po yung hinihintay namin sa kasalukuyan.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So hopefully po, hanggang before third week na September, baka po maging maliwanag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Doon sa 8 billion po na nagastos na po, how much was merely obligated versus magkano po yung paid and delivered?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Tapos in addition po, ito po bang na-procure nyo na or nagastos no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Can it still be used for next year's election if it will be postponed next year?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: More or less po, Mr. Chair, ang earmark natin is 4 billion.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At ang ating naman din pong obligated, more or less din po, 3.9, 4 billion na rin po halos ang obligated natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So all in all po, 8 billion, 3 million ang atin pong obligated at saka earmark na amount.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At yan naman po, para po doon sa mga nakikinig at nakamonitor sa atin, lahat naman po yun ay magagamit.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: kung sakaling hindi matuloy ang ating halalan sa 26 November 2.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Okay po. So thank you po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: On my second point, kasi po nagkaroon po recently ng election sa Das Marinas in Cavite.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: And according to news article in your report,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: from your supposed 200 million budget, napababa niyo po ng 128 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Plus, meron pa pong contribution yung ating LGU na around 50 million po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Tama po ba yan, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Napakalaking tulong po yung in advance sa amin po ng local government unit ng Das Marinas Cavite.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Gusto ko lang din pong sabihin for record purposes.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Na ang omnibus election code under Section 10 ay nagsasabi na si Comelec,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Whether we agree with that or not, it's a 1985 law.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Sabi po, the Comelec can ask the local government unit to advance expenses that will be incurred

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: for purposes of the conduct of any special election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung po yung ginawa sa atin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At this point po, Mr. Chair, hindi naman po namin po mababayaran o maibabalik sa LGU

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: sapagkat kinakailangan po muna may pumasok na savings.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang Supreme Court sa atin sa DAP cases, savings can only be incurred kapag po natapos na ang year.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And therefore, sa ngayon, wala pa po kami savings para maibalik.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Napakalaking tulong po yun sapagkat ginamit po namin yung 50 million sa pagpapabigay ng onorarya sa ating mga guro.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And for the information likewise of the body, for the second time in the history of the Commission,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: on the night of the election, nabayaran po namin ang lahat ng mga guro na nagsilbi sa election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Una na po ang antipolo dito po sa Das Marinas.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi po kami naghintay ng 15 days.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: On the same night, nagbayad na rin po kami sa mga guro.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So again, that is still subject to reimbursement.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yan naman po yung exact wordings ng batas natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Actually, hindi rin po aware na it was an advance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: But is it common practice po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: I know you mentioned na nasa batas po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Is it common practice na ang LGU, pag nagkakaroon po ng vacancy, nag-a-advance po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: And wala po bang, siyempre may mga nag-raise po ng issue na since yung tumakbo is part of the LGU,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: there's some sort of conflict of interest.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Actually po, may mga nag-question, especially sa social media.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Lalo na po sa part ng local government unit, hindi naman po sa part ni Comel.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: sabi namin, ang pag-gastos ng kahit anong item, kami ang may final say, kami ang may desisyon,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: hindi yung nagbigay na local government unit.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ito po yung pangatlong pagkakataon na ang Comelic ay nabigyan ng advance.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Sa bandang huli po, hindi po ba kahit sa Republic Act 7160, yung ating local government code, hindi po ba ang SK naman, hindi pwedeng gumasta ng kahit anong pondo, nang hindi po otorisado at under the control and supervision ng barangay.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So yung sinasabing hindi nagagasos ng tama, ay di dapat din po nabiblaim din pala si barangay chairman sapagkat lahat po ng apaggasos ng SK ay may imprimatur ng barangay chairman at sa kabarangay council.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So meaning to say po, hindi po ito kasalanan lang ng kabataan. Madami po magagawa dahil ang kabataan nagiging parte nung nalalaman po nila kung paano pinapamahalaan ang bayan, paano inaayos ang paggasos ng pondo.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kung meron po ilan na nagiging palpak o nagiging bulok, hindi po dapat mablaim yung karamihan sapagkat nung kabataan barangay pa lang maayos naman po eh. Ito pong sangguni ang kabataan maayos din naman po.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And therefore, naniniwala po ang inyong lingkod kahit po ang buong komisyona that SK should never and should not be abolished.

segments.speaker: Rep. Amado Carlos A. Bolilia IV
segments.text: Thanks for the enlightenment. Pagdating naman po sa voters education na plan ng Comelec.

segments.speaker: Rep. Amado Carlos A. Bolilia IV
segments.text: Tayo po ba'y mayroong inovasyon o may pinaplanong o may iniisip na kapamaraanan na hindi na laging tuwing last two days na lang ng registration or last day,

segments.speaker: Rep. Amado Carlos A. Bolilia IV
segments.text: doon na lamang mag-pukuyugin, doon na lang pupunta yung mga would-be registrants sa pagkaparehistro. It's all about voters education and information na plan ng inyong tanggapan.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Alam niyo po, Mr. Chair, Your Honor, noong pong August 1 to 9, siyam na araw lang po yun. Kasi kaya po kami nagparehistro noong August 1 to 9 noong nakaraang taon, kasi nga po meron po kasi tayong,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: barangay ng SK election dapat ng December. Kaya August 1 to 9 lang ang aming pong window para magpaparehistro.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Mahigit tatlong milyon po ang pumunta sa registration sites natin. Ibig sabihin, talagang interesado sila magparehistro, magpatransfer ng registration, magpachange ng kung anumang item sa kanilang registration o magparevive ng kanilang registration.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kung kaya nga lang, madami rin po kasing na-deactivate ng mga votante na hindi nakaboto noong 2022 at syempre noong 2023.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Barangay ng SK election. So ano pong ibig sabihin natin?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung pong mahabang panahon, totoo po talagang binabanggit niyo po. Kahit na anong klaseng kampanya, simbahan, paaralan, civil society, talaga pong hindi kami tumitigil.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ginamit na po namin pati po social media para hindi kayati na magparehistro. For whatever reason, talagang mga last three days, saka sila po pumupunta sa registration.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Nagsasatellite. Meron pa nga po kami, kanina binanggit ko.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Registration anywhere, anytime. Anytime, kahit sa hospital po, gabi, pati mga pasyente, nagbabatay sa pasyente.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung pong nasa call centers para yung mga nagtatrabaho, wala nang dahilan na hindi makapagparehistro.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: In fairness po, highly anticipated. Ano po nila yun? Accepted. Tinangga po nila yung aming pong mga bagong innovation po na ganoon.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: In fact, ito po yung isa sa mga nabigyan ng awards. Ergonomy Award. Yung registration anywhere. Ngayon po may anytime pa.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Sa mga airports. So, kung kahit po mga katutubo, dinadala po na namin ang registration sa kanila.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi po yung naglalakad sila mula doon sa bundok, papunta sa kapatagan. But just the same, hindi pa rin po sapat.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Meron. Kita nyo po, Mr. Chair. Alam nyo po ba na ang ating deactivated? Meaning yung hindi nakabotong botante.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: For the last two elections ay 3 million. So, ibig sabihin, dapat yung 3 million na yun ay magpareactivate para makaboto sila sa 2028 election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang iba hindi po nagpareactivate para sa barangay and SK elections. So, yung po ang isang problema natin na dadagdagan pero nababawasan din sapagkat mga hindi po nakakaboto ng dalawang magkasunod na election na yung po ang nakalagay naman sa ating Republic Act 8189.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung continuing registration. But huwag po kayo mag-alala. Sisuguro din po namin lalo ang kabataan. Sila po ay magpaparehistro at boboto. Yung po ang importante. Critical.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
Rep. Amado Carlos A. Bolilia IV
segments.text: Maraming salamat. Last question na lang po. Sa Philippine Development Plan 2023 to 2028, isa sa mahalagang papel ng COMELEC ay ang pagpapalawig ng inclusivity at accessibility ng mga elections sa bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Amado Carlos A. Bolilia IV
segments.text: Paano titiyakin ng COMELEC na ang pagpapalawak ng satellite at special registrations ay magiging inclusive lalo na para sa mga botante yung nasa geographically isolated?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Alam niyo po, yung kauna-unahan naming registration na ginawa para sa 2025, pumunta po kami sa Kalayaan Islands. Maaaring naiparehistro namin ay anim na po lang. Pero yun po ay napaka-symbolic kasi gusto naming ipakita sa lahat na kahit saan, mararating namin, magparehistro lang ng mga botante.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Number one, number two, na yung island na yan ay yung piece of property na yan ay sa Pilipinas. Sapagkat ang pinaparehistro namin, mga Pilipino. Pinuntahan po namin ang Camp Darapanan, ang Camp Abu Bakar, pinakamalalaking kampo ng MILF. First time na nagpa-register po diyan. Ibig sabihin, sobra pong init ng pagtanggap.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Dalawang araw po hindi pa natatapos ang registration. Pinuntahan po namin ang bulubundukin ng Bukidnon at saka yung pong tinatawag na Camp Dragon diyan po sa Sulu. Hindi na po bale may threat, may security, whatever. Importante makita ng mga kababayan natin na sila'y nagparehistro.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yun po ay talagang mga kabataan po ang nagparehistro naman. So, yung mga kampanyang yan, tama naman po kayo na dapat mas mapaigting pa natin. At dapat po, Mr. Chair, Your Honor, yung mga nakatatanda, mga may kapansanan, ang mga nagdadalang-tao at lalong-lalo na po katutubo.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung ating persons deprived of liberty, 68,000 po sila more or less, yung mga nakakulong. Sinisigurado po namin na nakakaboto sila kahit sa Bureau of Corrections at saka po sa BJMP ay makakaboto po sila. So para po yang lahat ng yan ay mapatunayan natin na inclusiveness ay pinakaimportante sa lahat. Wala po tayong dapat iiwan.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Meron po tayong mga lugar dati, kahit yung kapihan na naging sikat dati sa Surigao, pinuntahan po namin yun. Yung mga lugar po ng mga indigenous peoples natin na apat na oras, limang oras nilalakad, pinupuntahan na rin po namin lahat yan para maiparehistro lang sila. First time, 80 years old, 85 years old, nagpaparehistro po sila. Mula sa Mindoro, sa Bukidnon, sa Tarlac, sa Zambales, kahit po sa Pampanga and such other places and Palawan. So, pero po madami pa rin po tayong mga kababayan na kinakailangang ma-reach ng komisyon. Kung kaya nga po yung pagtanggal sa amin ng budget na katulad na nabanggit ni Congresswoman Elago kanina, malaking bagay po yun sapagkat baka hindi na po namin sila basta marating dahil dito sa pagkaltas ng budget ng Commission on Elections. But ipinapangako po namin sa inyo, we will never leave anybody unregistered because disenfranchisement is never the business of this republic. Disenfranchisement is never the business of the Commission on Elections. Again, maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Amado Carlos A. Bolilia IV
segments.text: And with that, Mr. Chairman, I would like to manifest and support the restoration

segments.speaker: Rep. Amado Carlos A. Bolilia IV
segments.text: of the proposed budget cut for COMELEC for the year 2027. Again, Mr. Chairman, thanks for your service to the Filipino people. Maraming salamat po. [palakpakan]

segments.text: Thank you, Cong. Kaloy. Thank you, Cong. Kaloy Bolilia. And next to interpolate, with permission from our vice chairs Cong. Zia and Cong. Rufus, would like to call on Representative Egay Erice.

segments.text: Again, good evening—good evening na po kanina. Good afternoon, Mr. Chair. Dinisqualify niyo ako; sana hindi na maulit.

segments.text: At ang sabi ng Supreme Court, "You committed a grave abuse of discretion in disqualifying me." Ang pinagmulan po niyan ay yung aking advocacy para sa political and electoral reforms. At sa tingin ko kasi ang pinakamalaking problema ng bansa natin kaya tayo bumabagsak ay political at electoral. At yan po yung aking mga advocacy in many, many proposals before the separation and electoral.

segments.text: Ngayon po, nung nag-petition po ako against Miru nung nakaraan dahil sinabi ko prototype yan, bago yan, nakakatakot yan, at nung namang nag-work sinabi ko, okay, napatunayan ko. I've been a member of the Joint Congressional Committee on Automation for 12 years at marami naman po tayong experience diyan.
